summary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with 1 non-gating traceability advisory. Subject custody held at the dispatched digest and mode. The unique live DR-131 row and its seven-column header reproduce exactly, and the subject decomposes the acceptance cell into nine verbatim obligations with operative answers. It freezes one exact first-party bundled declarative pack identity, facts-plus-Coverage as sealed pure-core inputs, pack name/version membership in PlanId without a producing recipe, pure-core policyOutcome, typed Coverage-indeterminate behavior without silent syntax substitution, the preview's non-durable/conceptual identity posture, and a no-silent-promotion route to a future sealed Run. D-077 and D-078 are cited at their exact adoption commits; D-002's SARIF advertisement is reconciled by D-077's owner-recorded Route B drop and G17-inapplicability rather than by rewriting the command/platform surface. The subject invents no PlanId, finding, Run, evidence, Coverage, or D9 recipe or code; freezes no rule IR, algorithm, packaging adapter, threshold, or default numeric constant; and leaves DR-123's human/machine schema and exit generics with D-092. D-136 and D-137 are treated only as recordings of accepted candidates: DR-133, DR-117, and DR-131 all remain OPEN and unsatisfied. The advisory notes that DR-009/D-079's separately parked policyOutcome.derivationDigest could be named for audit convenience, but the subject neither defines nor relies on that recipe and its blanket section-7.1 prohibition already preserves the governing park.
